name: Start Deck 100 Battle Collection CoroCiao Version

releases.name: Start Deck 100 Battle Collection CoroCiao Version

description.text: Start Deck 100 Battle Collection CoroCiao Version, the deck that came with the first issue of CoroCiao, a new manga magazine made by CoroCoro Comic and Ciao, released on 19 December 2025 with the Start Deck 100 Battle Collection. Unlike those decks its contents were fixed, and it held a newly drawn Pikachu ex, announced as found nowhere else, whose attack does 210 damage and 30 to itself. It also has Influencer's Introduction, a Supporter that draws three cards as you introduce your favorite Pokémon to your opponent, who may say "Like!" if your love for it comes across. Its 23 cards carry the code MP1.
